rules.text: Use the frozen task and scope; read only relevant source ranges, not entire archives. Save each completed finding immediately.
Distinguish observed facts, inference and unknowns; cite fixed source anchors and counterexamples. Never invent or close unknowns without evidence.
Use existing Platform contracts and permissions; no direct database writes, weakened guards or copied incompatible source.
Do not change controller, frozen scope, gates, queue, state or existing tests; independent verification decides completion.
Study tasks change evidence only; implementation tasks change only assigned candidate packages and relevant design. Preserve unrelated work.
No commits, pushes, publishing or production tenant changes. Temporary probes are evidence, not final delivery.
Register proven platform gaps through the configured feedback path on implementation tasks; distinguish unverified hypotheses.
Return after one bounded attempt. If blocked, record the reason and next discriminating probe; do not repeat a failed approach blindly.
